label: New York
style: Fast-paced mix of polished workwear and downtown streetwear: black-heavy palettes, tailored coats, sneakers with everything, logo-light minimalism next to hip-hop-rooted street style.

label: London
style: Eclectic and irreverent: vintage and charity-shop finds, tailoring with a punk or subculture twist, trench coats, layering for grey weather, grime-influenced tracksuits.

label: Paris
style: Effortless, understated chic: neutral palettes (navy, camel, black, white), well-cut basics, trench coats, ballet flats and loafers, minimal jewelry, nothing that looks like it's trying.

label: Lagos
style: Bold and celebratory: vibrant Ankara and adire prints, tailored agbada and kaftans worn modern, statement colours and accessories, Afrobeats-driven luxe streetwear.

label: Nairobi
style: Practical and creative: kitenge and Maasai shuka prints mixed into everyday wear, upcycled and secondhand (mitumba) styling, earthy tones, layering for cool mornings.

label: Tokyo
style: Experimental and meticulous: avant-garde silhouettes, heavy layering, Harajuku street style, Ura-Hara streetwear, workwear and Americana done with obsessive detail, mixed textures.

label: Shanghai
style: Polished and trend-forward: sleek luxury pieces, modern takes on the qipao and mandarin collar, clean minimalist streetwear, high-low mixing, sharp accessories.

label: Sydney
style: Relaxed coastal ease: linen, breezy dresses, swim-to-street pieces, sneakers and slides, sun-washed neutrals and pastels, laid-back surf and athleisure.

label: Rio de Janeiro
style: Sun-soaked and body-confident: bright colours, beachwear worn into the city, crop tops, shorts and flip-flops, tropical prints, football-shirt street style.

label: Los Angeles
style: Casual and image-conscious: athleisure, oversized hoodies and vintage tees, denim, sneaker culture, skate and surf influences, celebrity-driven streetwear.

label: Johannesburg
style: Expressive and proudly local: Afro-urban streetwear, Basotho blanket and Shweshwe prints reworked, bold tailoring, Izikhothane-influenced flash, amapiano-era fits.

label: Milan
style: Luxurious and impeccably tailored: sharp suiting, rich fabrics, leather goods, sprezzatura, polished shoes, confident colour and quality-first dressing.

label: Seoul
style: Trend-driven and coordinated: K-pop-influenced streetwear, oversized silhouettes, clean layered outfits, matching sets, statement sneakers, soft and minimalist palettes.

label: Copenhagen
style: Playful Scandinavian minimalism: clean shapes with pops of colour and print, practical outerwear, bike-friendly dressing, sustainable and vintage pieces.

label: Berlin
style: Dark, utilitarian and nightlife-ready: all-black, techno and club culture, workwear and military pieces, chunky boots, anti-fashion attitude.

label: São Paulo
style: Urban and diverse: polished business looks beside skate and pixação-scene streetwear, Brazilian designer prints, sneakers, mixed cultural influences.

label: Dubai
style: Luxury and modest elegance: designer labels, flowing abayas and kanduras, statement sunglasses and jewellery, light fabrics for heat, high-shine glamour.

label: Toronto
style: Multicultural and practical: layered outerwear for cold winters, OVO and Drake-era streetwear, diverse cultural influences, clean casual city wear.

label: Luanda
style: Vibrant and rhythmic: bright samakaka and wax prints, kizomba and kuduro-influenced looks, tailored Angolan style, bold colour and confident accessories.

label: Mumbai
style: Colourful fusion of tradition and Bollywood: kurtas and sarees worn modern, Indo-western mixes, bright prints, light cottons for humidity, filmi glamour.
